snippet.title: College Football 26 Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
College Football 26 is available July 10. Pre-order to play 3 days early: http://x.ea.com/84146 
 
The playbook is in your hands. Take your career from high school recruit to Heisman or coach your team to the top. With thousands of new plays, players and upgraded abilities, there are more ways than ever to Bring Glory Home. 

Get #CFB26 news: https://linktr.ee/easportscollege
